title: Trace of a sequentially composed tree
statement: Let $A,B\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be disjoint, let $T$ be a finite decision tree querying coordinates in $A$, and let $K$ assign to each output of $T$ a finite decision tree querying coordinates in $B$. For every input $x$, the query trace of the tree that runs $T$ and then runs $K$ on the output of $T$ is the concatenation of the trace of $T$ and the trace of $K(T(x))$.
hypotheses_covered: A and B are disjoint coordinate sets
A finite decision tree T with coordinates available in A
A family K of finite decision trees with coordinates available in B
An input assigning an element of Ω to each of the n coordinates
